title: Listening Drill — Basketball training — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Basketball training — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on basketball training last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with slippery floor. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: leaking roof.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of shoe grip so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow water bottle instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the coach before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
